title: Map the flag-0 frames through the channel isometry
body:
## Summary
- The channel's stored label isometry sends event 5758's rank-8 frame to `[257, 129, 64, 32, 16, 8, 4, 2]` and its full frame to `[256, 128, 64, 32, 16, 8, 4, 2, 1]`.
- Those images are the physical columns of target 34's promote record. The stored dual Gram equals the native checker's inverse.
- No selected frontier change and no new exponent. The restore recipe is not checked here.

## Test plan
